name: JANUS-7
tagline: An MG3-based machine gun that transforms to hurl auto-tracking lightning.
summary: JANUS-7 is a 200-round 7.62mm machine gun designed by the Aegis Institute on the basis of the MG3. Its Janus Transformation System can be triggered (right-click, once the requirement is met) to enter Janus Form for 18 seconds, during which the gun deals electric damage that automatically tracks enemies within a short range.
description: The wiki describes JANUS-7 as a machine gun designed by the Aegis Institute based on the MG3, using 7.62mm ammunition, with a Janus Transformation System that can perform a lightning bolt attack for a certain period of time. When the activation requirement is met, right-clicking transforms the weapon; in Janus Form it emits electric damage that automatically tracks enemies within a short range, hitting nearby enemies omnidirectionally and chaining through multiple targets in sequence. Listed damage: 38 (Normal), 35 (Zombie), 143 (Scenario), and up to about 63,000 to a boss in Janus Form with maxed firepower. Accuracy is rated 73%, price $9,000, Janus Form lasts 18 seconds. Drawbacks are low accuracy, high recoil, heavy weight, a long reload, high cost, and the fact that the lightning cannot score headshots and focuses on one target at a time within a limited range.
